scenarios.title: Sustainable mobility launch
scenarios.summary: Turn a corporate press release into a structured LinkedIn thread with a RACE brief.
scenarios.situation: Your client "Horizon Mobility" launches a sustainable mobility offer for urban professionals. The source press release is in the brief below — produce a 3-post LinkedIn thread reassuring time-pressed executives about ROI and time saved.
scenarios.briefMarkdown:
## Horizon Mobility — Source press release (excerpt)

**Paris, March 12, 2026** — Horizon Mobility launches "Flow Urban", a mobility subscription combining e-bike, scooter, and public transit access for urban professionals.

- **Employer ROI**: internal study of 2,400 users — average 47 min/day saved on commutes (KPMG-audited methodology, March 2025).
- **Pricing**: €89/month per employee, 12-month commitment, no setup fees for companies with 50+ staff.
- **Coverage**: Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux from Q2 2026; Marseille and Lille in Q3.
- **CEO quote**: "We are not selling a gadget — we are making time lost in transit recoverable for collective performance."

**Editorial constraints**: sober tone, no emojis, ban delve / catalyst / game-changer phrasing.
constraints: Complete RACE brief required before generation
Ban: delve, tapestry, leverage, pivotal, game-changer
deliverables: Structured agency brief (Role, Context, Objective, Constraints, Format)
List of removed AI tics with justification
scenarios.narrationScript: Welcome to Block 1 workshop. You are Horizon Mobility's comms lead. The CEO wants a 3-post LinkedIn thread tonight from an overlong press release. Your mission: build a RACE agency brief, then command AI without letting generic jargon through. I'll guide you through client stakes and AI-ism traps. Interrupt me anytime to ask a question.

briefingSteps.hint: Horizon Mobility context, dense press release, 3-post LinkedIn thread, RACE and anti-jargon constraints.

briefingSteps.prompt: Share 3–4 steps you envision for structuring your RACE brief and LinkedIn thread
briefingSteps.voiceCue: Invite the student to submit their 3-4 steps in the deliverable panel below, then wait.

briefingSteps.hint: Comment on the submission, then detail expected deliverables and the first concrete action.

scenarios.title: Anti-AI jargon audit
scenarios.summary: Rewrite an AI-generated draft by removing hollow phrasing.
scenarios.situation: Your manager sends a ChatGPT draft internal memo on digital transformation. The tone is recognizably "AI" and must be rewritten for a demanding leadership team before sending to 2000 employees.
constraints: Keep facts, change only style and structure
Use explicit bans/prefer tags in the prompt
deliverables: Rewrite prompt with XML bans/prefer tags
Table: AI phrasing → human phrasing (5 examples)
scenarios.narrationScript: Editorial audit scenario. You inherit an internal memo full of AI jargon. Your professional credibility depends on the rewrite. We'll identify tics, build an effective negative prompt, and produce a publishable version. Ask if any passage still sounds too machine-like.

scenarios.title: LinkedIn carousel — art direction
scenarios.summary: Create and critique key visuals for a corporate campaign.
scenarios.situation: Following Block 1's mobility launch, you must produce a 5-slide LinkedIn carousel: navy/white charter, authentic photos (no plastic stock), message aligned with the copy thread.
constraints: Visual prompts with explicit angle, lighting, palette
No deepfake faces without EU AI Act disclosure
scenarios.narrationScript: Art direction workshop. You move from text to image for the same Horizon Mobility client. I'll detail the situation, brand constraints, and Firefly vs Midjourney legal risks. You'll then experiment with recommended tools. Raise your hand to clarify a visual prompt.

scenarios.title: EU AI Act visual compliance
scenarios.summary: Choose the right tool under strict legal constraints.
scenarios.situation: A European luxury brand requires web banners with provenance metadata and watermarking. Your team tested Midjourney—legal refused. You must reproduce creative intent in Firefly.
constraints: Document compliance chain (3 AI Act layers)
Sober visual tone, no generic AI stock aesthetic
deliverables: Metadata + disclosure procedure for the client
scenarios.narrationScript: Compliance scenario. Legal just blocked Midjourney for public assets. You must deliver under EU AI Act Article 50. We'll walk through the situation, three transparency layers, and your Firefly workflow. Questions welcome on indemnification and training data provenance.

scenarios.title: 30-second Reel script
scenarios.summary: Decline a long article into a punchy vertical script.
scenarios.situation: Horizon Mobility's 1000-word blog post must become a 30s Instagram Reel: aggressive hook, paced body, CTA for free trial signup.
scenarios.narrationScript: Short-format workshop. Same campaign, new format: 30 seconds to stop the scroll. I present Hook-Body-CTA structure and the fragmented video stack. You'll produce the script then can test with ElevenLabs or your usual tools.

scenarios.title: Whitepaper to animated infographic
scenarios.summary: Orchestrate multi-tool declination from the source document below.
scenarios.situation: The mobility whitepaper excerpt below must feed: a 45s LinkedIn script for investors, and a storyboarded infographic for Knowlify.
scenarios.briefMarkdown:
## Mobility whitepaper — Excerpt (do not invent figures)

**Title**: Urban mobility 2026 — data and scenarios

1. **Market**: +12% annual growth in multimodal subscriptions in Western Europe (2024-2025).
2. **Investor stake**: 18% reduction in professional travel costs over 3 years for pilot enterprises (n=120).
3. **Risk**: saturation of "all-in-one" offers without audited ROI — decision-makers require verified metrics.
4. **Opportunity**: 45s investor scripts on LinkedIn (+34% completion vs text-only posts, Horizon internal source).

Use only these data points for the script and storyboard.
constraints: Do not hallucinate figures absent from the source document above
Document workflow in at least 4 steps
scenarios.narrationScript: Advanced declination scenario. The source document is on screen in the brief — deliver two formats without losing the strategic message. We cover extraction, investor script, and storyboard. Interrupt to verify a fact or tool choice.
